decisionsTitle: The backoffice says when each person loses the place
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-02 morning, from his phone**, with the 21 November race full — 134 confirmed, 16 holding a place with the declaration unsigned, 7 awaiting the email, 10 waiting: «Când pierde lumea locul? Trebuie să apară asta în back-office».

**What the backoffice said until now.** The answer was spread over code and settings, and shown in one place only: the registration's own page said «Rezervarea expiră: <date>». The editor's confirmation card says the window's two dates; the list's journey cell («3/6 · Loc rezervat») said nothing of a deadline, not even in its hover title. Two days before a race the club, looking at the event's list, could not see who was about to lose a place, nor when.

**The rules, as the code applies them.** This decision changes none of them; it says them.

- **The declaration hold** (`computeDeclarationHoldExpiry`). A place given before the event's participation window opens (§104: `confirmation_opens_days_before`, 7 by default; `confirmation_deadline_days_before`, 2) is the person's until the window's deadline — start minus the deadline's days, or the start itself when that is 0 (§407) — and is not capped by the close. Inside the window, and on an event without one, the club's `holdMinutes` («Termene», §377: 30 by default, 10–120), counted from when the declaration email leaves (§513) and capped by the close and the start.
- **Past its deadline (§160)** a hold is not released by the clock. `expireStaleHolds` releases `waiting − free` lapsed holds, the oldest deadline first, where `waiting` is the `WAITLISTED` rows (plus, §348, a newcomer the line has no room for) and `free` the places free without touching a hold. It runs under the event lock on every allocator path — a newcomer's address confirmed (`placeForNewcomer`, and the second pass when the line grows), a cancellation, «Trimite-i oferta» (`offerPlaceToByStaff`), «Dă-i un loc», the editor's capacity raise — and in the maintenance job, whose scan selects an event with a lapsed hold somebody waits for whatever its `waitlist_auto_offer` (`findEventsNeedingMaintenance`), and whose `fillAvailableSpots` sweeps before §615's gate. So **in both settings** of «Locurile din lista de așteptare se alocă automat» the hold is released as soon as somebody waiting has no free place. What follows differs: with «Da», before the close, the place is offered to the first in line in the same transaction; with «Nu» it stays free until the organizer hands it out with «Trimite-i oferta» (before the close) or «Dă-i un loc»; after the close, in either setting, no offer is made (§420) and the desk's «Dă-i un loc» gives it. With no waiting list (a limit of 0) the one who wants it is a newcomer who finds no other place free (§348); an uncapped event never wants one. At the start every unsigned hold is released, and the desk can still confirm a paper declaration into a place still free (§160). **Nothing is emailed** when a hold is released: `expireStaleHolds` writes `EXPIRED` with `DECLARATION_HOLD_LAPSED` in bulk and queues no message.
- **The first email's link** (`email_link_expires_at`): `confirmationHours` (48 by default, 12–168) from when it leaves (§513). A `PENDING_EMAIL_CONFIRMATION` row holds no place — a family's reservation excepted, until its sitting's deadline (§543) — and expires with the link (`expireStalePendingEmailConfirmations`, silently).
- **A waiting-list offer**: `offerHours` (24 by default, 6–72) from when its email leaves (§520), capped by the close and the start. Unsigned, it lapses silently (`WAITLIST_OFFER_EXPIRED` is never queued, §331); the place goes to the next in line with «Da» while registration is open, and stays free with «Nu».
- **A confirmed registration** never loses its place except by a cancellation.

**Decision: one sentence family, one builder.** `registrations/domain/place-deadlines.ts#placeDeadlineSentences` is pure: the event's window, limits, setting, close and status, the club's deadlines, counts of real registrations, the clock, the locale and the zone in; short sentences out — each under 200 characters (§511), every number the setting's (§377), every date through `formatDay` (short, with the time). In order:
- who has to sign, and until when: «16 persoane au de semnat declarația și își țin locul până joi, 19 nov. 2026, la 10:00 (cu 2 zile înainte de start).», or «…până la start.» for a deadline of 0;
- with the window open, who keeps its deadline («Cine și-a confirmat adresa înainte de … își ține locul până …») and how long a new hold lasts («Cine își confirmă adresa de acum are cel mult 30 de minute să semneze, de când pleacă emailul.» — not after the close);
- how many are past it: «9 persoane au termenul depășit; locul li se ține cât nu-l cere nimeni.»;
- what a passed deadline does, in the one variant the code does for this event: «Da», «Nu», after the close, no waiting list, no limit — e.g. «După termen locul nu se pierde singur: se eliberează doar când cineva de pe lista de așteptare n-are alt loc liber, și i se oferă primului din listă.»; not while every deadline is the start itself;
- the start: «La start, cine n-a semnat pierde locul; la masă poate fi confirmat pe hârtie, dacă mai e un loc liber.»;
- the email's link, with the family's exception when a reservation holds: «7 persoane n-au confirmat încă adresa: linkul e valabil 48 de ore de când pleacă emailul, apoi înscrierile expiră; până atunci nu țin niciun loc.»;
- the open offers, by setting: «…valabilă cel mult 24 de ore de când pleacă emailul; nesemnată la timp, trece la următorul din listă cât sunt deschise înscrierile.» / «…locul rămâne liber până îl dai tu.».

A count of zero drops its sentences; a cancelled or finished event gets none. English equivalents for each, in the same keys (`Admin.registrations.placeDeadlines.*`, counted through `countForm`).

**Where it shows, and why there.**
- **The registrations list scoped to one event**, right under «Cine s-a înscris», headed «Când se pierde un loc»: it is the screen the club reads two days before the race. Not on the list over every event, where no single window or setting is true of every row.
- **The event's «Înscrierile primite»**, under its buttons, beside the bulk resend of the declaration.
- **The queue panel**, the held places' sentences only, beside «Rezervate», in the event's own zone like every other time on that panel (§369).

One grouped query (`admin-repository.ts#readPlaceDeadlines`: the event's row and its real registrations counted by filter), read once per page; the event's page hands it to the queue panel. Real rows only: a test registration is in no number the club is given (§12.6) — the allocator's `countOccupied`, which counts them by design, is not read for it. Every role that reads the registrations sees the sentences, the Organizer too (§289); the Tehnic role reads no list and gets nothing new.

**Every row.** The «Unde a ajuns» cell keeps its step and adds the deadline the row's state waits on: «ține locul până joi, 19 nov. 2026, la 10:00»; past it «termen depășit, locul se ține cât nu-l cere nimeni» (the journey's kept words, which said «cât nu așteaptă nimeni» — now the block's own, since a newcomer can want the place too, §348); «loc oferit, până …»; «linkul expiră …» or «linkul a expirat» on a row still waiting for its address, read from `email_link_expires_at`, a column of the row added to the list's select (no join, no query per row); «loc rezervat până …» on a family's reservation while it holds. The step stays on one line and the deadline wraps at 320 px; the hover title is unchanged; an ended row names no deadline. The registration's page says the same: its timeline's «Rezervarea expiră» reads «Ține locul până» on a live hold, with the kept words past a declaration's deadline, and stays on an ended row; a row waiting for its address gains «Linkul din email expiră».

**The guide.** «Retrimite declarația celor care nu au semnat» gains one step: where the deadlines show now.

*Rejected:*
- **A countdown, or any new deadline.** The rules are the existing ones, and the owner asked to see them, not to change them.
- **A per-row query of the queue** to say whether a kept hold will survive the next visit: §160 already chose the condition in words for a list that spans events.
- **The block on the list over every event.** Its sentences would be true of some rows and false of others.
- **Reading `countOccupied` for the counts.** It is the allocator's, and counts test rows on purpose.

**Consequences.** New: `registrations/domain/place-deadlines.ts`, `registrations/ui/PlaceDeadlines.tsx`. Changed: `admin-repository.ts` (`readPlaceDeadlines`; `emailLinkExpiresAt` on the list's and the detail's rows), `domain/journey.ts` (the `link` detail, `reservedUntil`, an optional `emailLinkExpiresAt`), `ui/StaffJourney.tsx`, `ui/QueuePanel.tsx`, the registrations list, the event's page, the registration's page; both catalogues (`Admin.registrations.placeDeadlines.*`, `journey.holding`, `link`, `linkLapsed`, `reserved`, `heldKept`'s words, `holdKeeps`, `linkExpires`, the guide's step). No schema, allocator, deadline, job or email change; `kind` in no allocator condition. Tests: `tests/unit/registrations/place-deadlines.test.ts` (both languages; the window ahead, a deadline of 0, the window open, no window; «Da» and «Nu»; after the close; no list, no limit; a family; zero counts; past-deadline holds; every sentence under 200 characters), `tests/unit/registrations/staff-journey-deadlines.test.ts` (each row state, both languages, the full journey), `tests/integration/registrations/place-deadlines-screens.test.ts` (the list scoped to an event for the Administrator and the Organizer, real rows only, none over all events, the Tehnic refused; the queue panel; «Înscrierile primite» handing the panel its one read).
changelogLine: - **The backoffice says when each person loses the place** — under «Cine s-a înscris» of one event, in «Înscrierile primite» and beside the queue's «Rezervate»: until when places are held, what a passed deadline does under either waiting-list setting, how long the email's link and an offer last, all with the club's own numbers; and every row's «Unde a ajuns» names its own deadline. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the registrations list or a registration's page, when a registration is still under way, then its journey names, after its step, the deadline its state waits on — a held place «ține locul până …» or, past it, «termen depășit, locul se ține cât nu-l cere nimeni»; an open offer «loc oferit, până …»; a row waiting for its address «linkul expiră …» or «linkul a expirat», read from the row's own `email_link_expires_at` with no query per row; a family's reservation «loc rezervat până …» — the step on one line and the deadline free to wrap at 320 px, the hover title kept, an ended row naming none; and the registration's page says «Ține locul până» on a live hold and «Linkul din email expiră» on a row waiting for its address (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given one event's registrations list, its «Înscrierile primite» box or its queue panel, when they render, then they say — counting real registrations only, every number from the club's «Termene» and the event's participation window — how many have to sign and until when (the window's deadline, «la start» for a deadline of 0, or the club's minutes inside the window and without one), how many are past their deadline and that the place is kept while nobody asks for it, what a passed deadline does as the allocator does it for that event (released only when somebody waiting has no free place; offered to the first in line with automatic offers before the close, left free for «Trimite-i oferta» or «Dă-i un loc» without them, given at the desk after the close, taken by a newcomer when there is no waiting list, never on an uncapped event), and how long the first email's link and a waiting-list offer last; a count of zero says nothing, the list over every event says none of it, and the Tehnic role gets none of it (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The backoffice journey's words for a declaration hold kept past its deadline are «termen depășit, locul se ține cât nu-l cere nimeni» / “deadline passed, the place is kept while nobody asks for it”, in place of criterion 8's «cât nu așteaptă nimeni»: since §348 a newcomer the waiting list has no room for can want the place too (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
